description: This is a Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing transaction data in a Flutter application's database. It provides methods to retrieve transactions by month, calculate total expenses per month, summarize expenses by category, and list available months, all via SQL queries to an SQLite database.

classes.name: TransactionDao
classes.description: A class that manages database operations related to transactions, such as fetching transaction data for specific months, calculating totals, and summarizing expenses by category.

methods.name: getByMonth
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a specific month, including category details, ordered by date and id descending.

methods.name: totalForMonth
methods.description: Calculates the total amount spent in a specified month.

methods.name: sumByCategory
methods.description: Provides a summary of expenses grouped by category for a specific month.

methods.name: monthsAvailable
methods.description: Returns a list of all months for which transaction data exists.
